Messages.Author: Henke
Messages.Body:
"Malleable Visage
Action modifier
Card Text:

<i>Usable when an ally you control is blocked, before combat begins. The
combat is canceled; untap the acting minion and tap this modifying vampire.
This vampire enters combat with the blocking minion.
<s>As above, but usable when a vampire you control is blocked."

Is this usable by a tapped vampire?



By card text, no. That's an error, however. So:
ERRATA: Malleable Visage is playable only by an untapped vampire.

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <9hd20d$g2v$1...@taliesin.netcom.net.uk>,



Yes. Tapped vampires can play action modifiers by default (else no-one
could play stealth, as they tap when the action is taken), and nothing
in Malleable Visage's text requires the playing vampire to be untapped
(contrast Hidden Lurker).

It does say to tap the modifying vampire, but you can tap a tapped
vampire.

Hm. I might not trade away my extra MV after all.

gomi

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Blood of the Cobra (conceptually) allows the vampire to spit blood
as a delivery mechanism, rather than coating a blade or a hand with
the blood. The current card text and subsequent rulings are in line
with this, and the result is not improper.

You'll also notice that the errata above is restrictive (makes the
card weaker), whereas the errata you're advocating would boost
(slightly) the power of BotC.


